verdict.rationale: Proa's own docs show it emits server-rendered HTML plus small vanilla-JS island modules, CSS-only components that ship no JavaScript, and charts drawn as plain server-side SVG. That output becomes real DOM inspectable in the browser, so the core premise of the story is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: any explicit claim about real-DOM or no-virtual-DOM rendering, any documentation of a devtools debugging workflow (e.g. mapping DOM nodes or island state back to components), and hands-on corroboration.
